info.title: LoanDesk Credit Score (mock)
info.description: Returns a made-up credit score for a fictional business ID. Demo only: not a real credit check.

get.description: Gets the mock credit score (300 to 900) for a business ID. For credit officers only; never show the score to a customer.

parameters.name: businessId
parameters.description: The business ID from the loan application, for example BIZ-100001.

400.description: The business ID is missing or not in an accepted format.

404.description: The credit bureau has no file for this business ID.

checkedAt.description: When the score was looked up (UTC).

mock.description: Always true: the score is made up.
